name: GMT7 trading helper's buy and sell functions are public and pay the caller
summary: The unverified GMT7 helper holds USDT and GMT7 and lets any caller run buyTokenAmount, which spends the helper's USDT on GMT7, and robotSell2me, which sells a fixed batch of the helper's GMT7 into the GMT7/USDT pair and sends the USDT to the caller. The attacker made the helper buy 945,902 GMT7 with its 3,023 USDT and then called robotSell2me 45 times, selling 3.57m of the helper's GMT7 for 10,327 USDT paid to itself.
notes: The operator's later 0xb48eb86e call (slot 0x13) only lowered the GMT7 batch each robotSell2me sells, which sets the loss per call, so the deployment is the reset.

Campaign: the helper's GMT7 and USDT outflows since deployment; before the anchor its GMT7 sales (up to 237,600 GMT7, in users' 0x6f9f2b48 calls) paid the USDT back to the helper and its USDT payments were 100 to 200 each, so the anchor is the only drain. GMT7 has no price; the helper's net 2.62m GMT7 is valued at the 7,304.38 USDT the pair paid out for it beyond the helper's own USDT (rule 12).
